editorial:
When a freak hurricane hits Los Angeles, it scoops up man-eating sharks into tornadoes and floods the city with shark-infested water. You follow surfer and bar-owner Fin as he teams up with his friends Baz and Nova to rescue his estranged wife April and teenage daughter Claudia. The whole thing is wild, silly, and totally over-the-top in the best way. It knows exactly what kind of movie it is and never pretends to be anything more than a fun, crazy ride.

The acting is cheesy but charming, and the action moves fast enough to keep you entertained. The special effects are rough, but that actually adds to the fun. On the downside, the plot is thin and some scenes drag. If you love campy disaster movies, you will have a blast. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Fin and his friends use a helicopter to drop bombs into the tornadoes, destroying the sharks. Fin jumps into a shark's mouth to save Nova, then chainsaws his way out. April and Claudia are rescued. The city is saved, and Fin's family is reunited. It is a ridiculous but satisfying ending that leans fully into the absurd premise.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy disaster movies and silly shark action.
